title: Check OPC connection status for tipper tags in Ignition Gateway (Config > OPC > OPC Connections)
summary: Use the Ignition Gateway web view to view current OPC connection entries for tipper tags. The source example shows tipper 7 and tipper 8 entries as Faulted when the tippers are powered off.
when_to_use: When you need to confirm the current OPC connection status shown for specific tipper tags (example: tipper 7 and tipper 8) using the Ignition Gateway web view.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Navigate the Ignition Gateway web view to Config > OPC > OPC Connections and verify the displayed connection status for the referenced tipper entries.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the Config > OPC > OPC Connections screen

visual_references.description: Ignition Gateway UI path showing Config > OPC > OPC Connections and example where tipper 7 and 8 show Faulted when powered off.

steps.title: Open Ignition Gateway web view and navigate to Config > OPC > OPC Connections
steps.purpose: Reach the live Ignition Gateway screen that displays current OPC connection entries for tipper tags.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition Gateway web view, navigate to Config > OPC > OPC Connections.
steps.expected_result: The Config > OPC > OPC Connections page loads and is ready to display the current OPC connection entries.
steps.healthy_condition: The OPC Connections view is visible in the Ignition Gateway web view (no missing/blank page).
steps.failure_condition: The page does not load, or the OPC Connections view is not accessible.

actions.label: Navigate to OPC Connections
actions.exact_action: Open the Ignition Gateway web view and navigate to Config > OPC > OPC Connections.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the Config > OPC > OPC Connections page, stop and escalate for deeper investigation.

steps.title: Locate the entries for the relevant tipper tags (example: tipper 7 and tipper 8)
steps.purpose: Identify the specific OPC connection entries corresponding to the tipper tags you are checking.
steps.instruction: On the OPC Connections view, locate the entries for the referenced tipper tags (the source example references tipper 7 and tipper 8).
steps.expected_result: You can find the OPC connection entries for the referenced tipper tags (e.g., tipper 7 and tipper 8) within the OPC Connections list.
steps.healthy_condition: The list contains entries for the referenced tipper tags and they are readable on the page.
steps.failure_condition: The OPC Connections page does not show the expected tipper entries.

actions.label: Find tipper entries
actions.exact_action: In the OPC Connections view, locate the entries for the relevant tipper tags (the source example references tipper 7 and tipper 8).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the OPC Connections page does not show the expected tipper entries, stop and escalate to support for deeper investigation.

steps.title: Check the displayed connection status for each tipper entry
steps.purpose: Determine whether the OPC connection status for each tipper tag is Faulted (as shown in the source example when powered off).
steps.instruction: For each referenced tipper entry (example: tipper 7 and tipper 8), read the displayed connection status on the OPC Connections page.
steps.expected_result: The OPC Connections view shows a connection status such as Faulted for the referenced tipper entries when they are powered off (as in the source example for tipper 7 and tipper 8).
steps.healthy_condition: The connection status displayed for each referenced tipper entry is consistent with the current system state you are investigating (e.g., Faulted when powered off, per the source example).
steps.failure_condition: The displayed connection status is not consistent with the expected status you are validating against (per the source example).

actions.label: Read connection status
actions.exact_action: Check the displayed connection status for each tipper entry; in the source example, both tipper 7 and 8 are powered off and show Faulted.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the OPC Connections page does not show a status consistent with the source example (Faulted when powered off), stop and escalate to support for deeper investigation.

steps.title: Compare what you see in the web view to the expected status for the referenced tipper tags
steps.purpose: Confirm whether the current OPC connection status matches the expected condition you are validating.
steps.instruction: Compare the connection status you read for the referenced tipper entries in the Ignition Gateway web view to the expected status from the source example (Faulted when powered off).
steps.expected_result: Your observed status for tipper 7 and tipper 8 matches the expected condition (Faulted when powered off) from the source example.
steps.healthy_condition: Observed connection status aligns with the expected condition you are validating (Faulted when powered off).
steps.failure_condition: Observed connection status does not align with the expected condition you are validating.

actions.label: Validate against expected status
actions.exact_action: Compare what you see in the web view to the expected status shown in the source example (Faulted when powered off).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the OPC Connections page does not show the expected tipper entries or does not show a status consistent with the source example, stop and escalate to support for deeper investigation.

success_criteria: You can access Ignition Gateway web view Config > OPC > OPC Connections.
The OPC Connections list contains entries for the referenced tipper tags (example: tipper 7 and tipper 8).
The displayed connection status for those entries matches the expected condition being validated (Faulted when powered off, per the source example).
healthy_conditions: OPC Connections page is reachable and shows current connection entries.
Referenced tipper entries display a connection status (e.g., Faulted) on the OPC Connections page.
failure_conditions: OPC Connections page does not show the expected tipper entries.
OPC Connections page does not show a status consistent with the expected condition being validated (per the source example).
escalation_guidance: If the OPC Connections page does not show the expected tipper entries or does not show a status consistent with the source example, stop and escalate to support for deeper investigation.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Ignition Gateway UI under Config > OPC > OPC Connections showing current connections; example where tipper 7 and tipper 8 are powered off and show Faulted.

missing_details: The source does not provide the exact Ignition Gateway URL/host for the Config > OPC > OPC Connections page (only that it is accessible via the web view).
The source does not define the full set of possible connection status values beyond the example 'Faulted'.
The source does not specify how to map a specific tipper tag name/ID to the corresponding row label in the OPC Connections list beyond the example of tipper 7 and tipper 8.
